title: Use xDrip+ as follower for Dexcom G6
symptom: As a follower, trying to log in to Dex Share Follower in Europe results in an error that account is missing code 500, likely because Europe connects to a different database.
cause: The user is in Europe and the app may be connecting to the wrong server (USA vs outside USA).
fix: Change the server setting to the appropriate region. Specifically, go to settings->cloud upload->dexcom share server upload->Dexcom usa based account and select the correct option for USA or outside USA.
settings_changed: Dexcom share server upload → Dexcom usa based account
evidence_quote: There is a setting option to choose whether you are using the USA or outside USA servers. It may confusingly be in the share upload section - Try that, you should be able to search preferences on Android 8 and above.
